svg.text: 21 numbered messages across four phases. Solid arrow = request, dashed = response. Boxes = what happens inside a step.
Goal: robotics / AI internship, target regions
Pages + public contact emails + source URLs
Keep only emails printed on an official page.
Read facts file + the one current CV
Write < 170 words: one detail of their work
+ one matching project from the facts file.
Claims checker: every sentence vs facts file.
Create draft, attach current CV (status = drafted)
Preview: recipient, subject, full body, attachment
Draft stays in Drafts. Nothing is sent.
Delete old output, then dry run: who would be mailed?
Before each mail: on allow list · not in sent_log
no STOP file · under daily cap · wait 3 to 8 min
Add meeting / deadline, alerts 1 d · 1 h · 30 m · 15 m
Log in status.md, out of office goes to the follow up list
